errors.text_span: Секторите са подредени според размера си, като по-големият сектор е разположен отдясно, а по-малкият - отляво.
errors.evidence: The description states that the sectors are ordered by size. While it is true that the larger sector is on the right and the smaller on the left, describing this as an "ordering" is an interpretation of spatial layout, not a description of an explicit feature of the chart, as pie charts do not have an inherent order.
